verdict.rationale: Google's account docs say that to sign in with just the security key and skip the password, you must create a passkey, which implies passkey storage on the key for Google sign-in (docs-2). However, the Titan product docs only name FIDO CTAP1 compatibility for third-party sites (docs-4), and nothing confirms discoverable/resident credentials or usernameless sign-in on other WebAuthn services. Missing for 10: explicit FIDO2/CTAP2 resident-key support documentation, evidence of usernameless sign-in on third-party WebAuthn services, resident-credential capacity/management details, independent hands-on corroboration.
